A vertical rural scene captures an expansive grain field glowing in rich shades of amber and gold beneath a low evening sun. In the lower center-right, an older farm worker stands among tall stalks of ripe grain, facing slightly away from the viewer with his head lowered toward his work. He wears a faded long-sleeved shirt with suspenders and dark work trousers. One hand holds the curved wooden handle of a traditional scythe, its long blade extending horizontally through the grain near his knees. Warm sunlight catches the edges of his hair, shoulders, clothing, and the surrounding stalks. The field stretches far into the distance, where a large weathered barn rises through a veil of golden haze on the left. Its dark silhouette and tall roof contrast softly against the illuminated landscape. Above, layered clouds fill a warm orange sky. The bright circular sun hangs in the upper right, accompanied by a loose formation of small birds flying nearby. Out-of-focus plants frame the foreground, adding depth and giving the scene the intimate quality of observing a quiet harvest from within the field.
